_doc: Load-bearing hybrid-quality held-out set (SC-014). 16 well-separated documents, 24 query/relevant pairs. Mix of paraphrase queries (favor semantic vector) and exact-term queries (favor keyword) so hybrid must stay competitive with the best single mode within the floor.

corpus.text: The application supports a dark mode theme that reduces eye strain at night for the analytics dashboard.
The database migration to the new schema is scheduled before the end of the quarter.
User authentication uses OAuth2 with refresh tokens and short lived access tokens.
The caching layer uses an LRU eviction policy with a configurable time to live.
Nightly backups are encrypted and replicated to a secondary region for disaster recovery.
Full text search is powered by an inverted index with BM25 relevance ranking.
Invoices are generated monthly and customers can pay by card or bank transfer.
Latency and error rate metrics are exported to the observability pipeline every minute.
New employees complete an onboarding checklist covering security and developer tooling.
The mobile client synchronizes offline edits when network connectivity is restored.
Personal data is anonymized before analytics processing to protect user privacy.
Continuous deployment promotes builds through staging and production with canary releases.
The interface is localized into several languages with right to left layout support.
API requests are rate limited per client using a token bucket algorithm.
Users can export their data as CSV or JSON archives on demand.
Notification preferences let users choose email, push, or in-app alerts.
